# 🦋 GMODebate.org
https://gmodebate.github.io/se/
In 2021, several scientific organizations boldly declared the GMO debate "over", citing the apparent fading of anti-GMO activism. The American Council on Science and Health, Alliance for Science, and Genetic Literacy Project, among others, proclaimed: The GMO debate is "over"

The founder discovered that many nature and animal protectors were in fact silent on GMO and animal eugenics. 🦋 GMODebate.org was founded in 2022 to facilitate an intellectual defense of nature through philosophy. 

Over the years, the founder developed a custom AI communication system and cold called tens of thousands of nature and animal protection organizations globally to ask them three questions about their vision on eugenics and GMO, to facilitate a "GMO debate". The result revealed that most organizations cited a "lack of time" excuse, which provides deeper philosophical insights into the real reason for lack of attention for GMO and eugenics when it concerns the well-being of animals and nature. The article that was the result after the conversation with people at Stop Ecocide International provides insights: [Brazil's GMO 🦟 Mosquito Disaster](/ecocide/) (use the domain base path for available languages).

> A public debate of scientism and 🧠⃤ Qualia with philosophy professor Daniel C. Dennett.

The 🦋 GMODebate.org project is part of a broader philosophical investigation of scientism, the philosophical root of 🧬 eugenics.

The founder is a long time defender of free will since 2006 through the Dutch critical blog 🦋Zielenknijper.com that investigated eugenics within a human context.

The 🦋 GMODebate.org project delves into the philosophical underpinnings of scientism, the "emancipation-of-science from philosophy" movement, the "anti-science narrative" and modern forms of scientific inquisition.

🦋 GMODebate.org contains an eBook of a popular online philosophy discussion titled "On the Absurd Hegemony of Science" in which renowned philosophy professor Daniel C. Dennett (known for his best seller "Darwin's Dangerous Idea") participated in defense of scientism.

For those interested in the views of Daniel C. Dennett, chapter "Dennett's Defense of His Rejection of 🧠⃤ Qualia" contains over 400 posts debating Dennett's rejection of the philosophical concept Qualia.

# Founder

The founder has investigated the roots of eugenics and dogmatic scientism (corruption of science) since as early as 2006 through the critical blog 🦋 Zielenknijper.com.

The blog Zielenknijper.com contains an investigation of political corruption surrounding the legislation of euthanasia in psychiatry. In 2010 Dutch psychiatrists enforced the right to euthanize their patients by releasing their patients to commit suicide on the streets, which looked like a political extortion tactic.

[Political Extortion and Euthanasia in Psychiatry](https://gmodebate.github.io/zielenknijper/en/euthanasia/)
> In 2010 Dutch psychiatrists enforced the right to euthanize their patients by releasing their patients to commit suicide on the streets, which looked like a political extortion tactic.

# MH17Truth.org
MH17Truth.org is a side project with investigations of various cases of corruption that was previously hosted on GMODebate.org.

While the project itself has a primary focus on the MH17 airplane attack, it is used by the author to host various other (from his perspective similar) investigations of corruption including "Hydrogen Scam of the Car Industry" and "Google's Corruption for AI Life Forms". The author is politically neutral and has no religious or financial interests.

One of the latest investigations is Google's corruption for AI life forms or its "digital species" that are to replace the human species for an apparent wicked techno eugenics related idea.

[Google's Corruption for 👾 AI Life](https://mh17truth.github.io/se/google/)
> An investigation of Google's corruption for AI life forms.

[Paranormal Assisted Investigation of the 9/11 Attack](https://mh17truth.github.io/se/911-truth/)
> The president of Turkey linked a terrorist attack in Utrecht, Netherlands to 👁️⃤ Christchurch Truth, shortly before an attack on the home of the founder of 🦋 GMODebate.org in Utrecht. An investigation revealed a link with NATO, 🇹🇷 Turkey and the 9/11 attack.

[The "9/11" of 🇳🇴 Norway](https://mh17truth.github.io/se/norway/)
> Norway, known for the Oslo Accords, was independently leading 🕊️ peace talks that almost prevented NATO's 2011 bombing of 🇱🇾 Libya. This investigation reveals that the 2011 terror attack originated from NATO to enforce their military intervention.

[Pedophilia in the Government and Justice System](https://mh17truth.github.io/se/pedophilia/)
> A critical investigation into pedophilia within the justice system. Video evidence concerning the rape of young children mysteriously disappeared before appointment as secretary general of Justice, whistleblowers threatened and silenced.

[Big Auto's Hydrogen Scam](https://mh17truth.github.io/se/hydrogen/)
> Hydrogen is often presented as emission-free with only water as a byproduct, but that is a lie. The industry is pushing highly toxic hydrogen 🔥 combustion engines and seeks to use politics to classify those engines as "emission free".

[Trafigura's Toxic Waste Crime in 🇨🇮 Ivory Coast, Africa](https://mh17truth.github.io/se/trafigura/)
> An undercover documentary about the toxic waste dumping crime in Ivory Coast, Africa by $230 billion USD oil company Trafigura. Due to an attempted cover up, the video was banned in the 🇬🇧 UK.

MH17Truth.org contains a translation into 54 languages of the Dutch book "MH17: A False Flag Terror Attack" that was part of an incident at the International Criminal Court (ICC) in the 🇳🇱 Netherlands.

The book is authored by the brother of Dutch 🧑‍⚖️ judge Charlotte van Rijnberk who worked at the ICC and who shared the book with her peers residing over the MH17 trial. The judge distributed the book to court officials and the House of Representatives in the Netherlands, while she described the MH17 trial as the result of corruption.

The book is available for free: https://mh17truth.github.io/se/mh17-book/download.html

# 🔭 CosmicPhilosophy.org

In 2025, the founder started CosmicPhilosophy.org that investigates the dogmatic nature of science. The project advocates that science should return to its original status "Natural Philosophy".

> # Albert Einstein versus Philosophy On The Nature of 🕒 Time And Philosophy's "Great Setback" For Scientism
> The shift from natural philosophy to physics started with Galileo and Newton's mathematical theories in the 1600s, however, energy and mass conservation were considered separate laws that lacked philosophical grounding.
> This changed fundamentally with Einstein's famous equation E=mc², which unified energy conservation with mass conservation. This unification created a kind of epistemological bootstrap that enabled physics to achieve self-justification, escaping the need for philosophical grounding altogether.
> This historical investigation of the Einstein-Bergson (science versus philosophy) debate that would cause "the great setback for philosophy" in history reveals that French philosopher Henri Bergson lost the debate on purpose for the advancement of scientism. Source: 🔭 CosmicPhilosophy.org
https://gmodebate.github.io/cosmos/se/einstein-vs-philosophy/

[The Attempt of Science to Escape Big Bang Cosmology](https://gmodebate.github.io/cosmos/se/einstein/)
> Read about the 2025 attempt of science to escape its Big Bang cosmology, the religious beginning of 🕒 time and Albert Einstein's conversion into a "believer".

[Albert Einstein Neutrinos Do Not Exist: The Dogmatic Attempt To Escape ∞ Infinite Divisibility](https://gmodebate.github.io/cosmos/se/neutrino/)
> The only evidence that neutrinos exist is "missing energy" and the concept contradicts itself in several profound ways. This case reveals that neutrinos originate from an attempt to escape infinite divisibility.

[The Moon Barrier: Were Plato and Aristotle right about life?](https://gmodebate.github.io/cosmos/se/moon-barrier/)
> Greek philosophers Plato and Aristotle predicted that life is restricted to a "sublunary sphere" below the Moon while science today never sent life beyond the moon. An investigation of this scientific mystery.
